cell.decayMonths: Month marks must increase and stay inside the scoring window

impact.title: Effect on existing partners
impact.sub: Calculated on real data, nothing is saved
impact.none: No unsaved change in this part.
impact.same: No partner changes score or level ({{n}} partners).

co.name: Company name
co.logoHint: PNG, JPG, SVG or WebP, square, up to 1 MB. Without a logo the first letter of the company name is used.
co.ownHint: Used to tell whether a contract is a purchase or a sale: which party is our company.
co.taxInvalid: Tax codes must have 10 or 13 digits
co.approvalOn: On: contracts go through approval before they take effect.
co.approvalOff: Off: saving a contract makes it effective immediately.

rep.title: Reputation score
rep.sub: Each product group and role has its own way of scoring.

how.ontime: Share of milestones on time; partner-caused delays cost extra points per day.
how.bad_count: 100 minus the penalty × bad jobs per 10 transactions.
how.jobs: Average score of manually logged jobs for the criterion.
how.on_time_delivery: % of deliveries on time, minus points for each day late caused by the supplier.
how.serial: % of serial / activation issued on time.
how.on_time_payment: % of payments on time, minus points for each day late caused by the partner.
how.renew_via_us: Score of logged renewals through us.
how.reminders: Few reminders: points lost per reminder per 10 transactions.
how.debt: Debt: points lost per debt case per 10 transactions.
how.complaints: Few unreasonable complaints: points lost per case per 10 transactions.
how.referral_support: Score of logged referred-customer support jobs.

f.crit1: Each criterion scores 0–100 as described under its name.
f.crit2: Data score = Σ (criterion score × weight) ÷ Σ weights.
f.crit3: Final score = {{a}}% data score + {{b}}% rating score (stars × 20).
f.crit3off: Final score = data score (manual rating is off).
f.levels: Levels: GOOD from {{good}}, FAIR from {{fair}}, below that WATCH.

time.f1: Each job counts by age: factor = the % set above. Jobs outside the scoring window have factor 0.
time.f2: Criterion score = Σ (job score × factor) ÷ Σ factors.
time.f3: So recent jobs weigh more than old ones.
time.allOut: All 3 jobs are outside the scoring window

types.title: Job types
types.hint: Manually logged jobs tied to this cell's criteria; score 0 = a counted bad job.
types.empty: No job types in this cell yet.
types.name: Job type name

common.order: The GOOD threshold must be higher than the FAIR threshold
common.gap: Require a reason when it differs by more than
common.lockHint: At the end of each month the app stores that month's score; locked scores are not recalculated.
common.f2: Final score = {{a}}% data score + {{b}}% rating score. Without ratings, 100% data score is used.
common.f2off: Manual rating is off: final score = data score.
common.f3: When the rating differs from the data score by more than {{gap}} points the rater must give a reason.
common.f4: Levels: GOOD from {{good}}, FAIR from {{fair}}, the rest WATCH.
common.needReason: Differs by more than {{gap}} points: a reason is required

biz.title: Business score
biz.sub: Suggestions to buy more, hold or dump stock on the Products & Prices page.
biz.f1: Score = Σ (factor × weight) ÷ Σ weights of factors that have data.
biz.f2: Stock: sales speed = 100 − (days of stock − 30) ÷ 1.5; packages: seats expected to sell before expiry ÷ seats held.
biz.f3: Margin ×400 (25% = 100); trend = 50 + (last 3 months − previous 3 months) ÷ previous 3 months × 50.
biz.f4: Holding stock: Buy more / Hold / Dump; not holding: Push / Keep / Consider stopping.

flow.title: Contract approval flow
flow.lead: Approval steps run in order. Step 1 is drafting and checking and always runs. Later steps may be conditional on contract type and value.
flow.loadFail: Could not load the approval flow.
flow.deptsFail: Could not load departments (admin access required).
flow.saveInvalid: The flow is not valid, see the highlighted fields
flow.name: Step name
flow.excludeStarter: The sender cannot approve this step
flow.firstNoCond: The first step always runs and has no condition.
flow.emptyValueNote: An empty value still requires this step.
flow.groupMissing: The department group no longer exists, choose again.
flow.conflict: The flow was changed by someone else, reload.

err.DUE_RANGE: Deadline must be a whole number of hours from 4 to 2160.
err.REMIND_RANGE: Reminder must be between {{min}} and {{max}} hours.
err.ESCALATE_SAME_GROUP: The escalation group must differ from the approving department.
err.FIRST_CONDITIONAL: The first step has no condition.
err.FIRST_NOT_REVIEW: The first step must be draft and check.
err.whenEmpty: Choose a contract type or value, or remove the condition.
err.amountInvalid: Amount must be a non-negative number.
err.AFTER_DIFY_CONDITIONAL: The step after a Dify step cannot have a condition.
